text:
Maya: Heads-up — eval CI failing on llama3-lite-q8 bring-up. Rerank NDCG dropped ~6% on canary. cc @Liam @Alex :eyes:
Liam: I saw the alert, grabbing logs now.
ci-bot: CI run 2026-03-19T14:12:02Z — tests: eval-harness/checks FAILED (summary: rerank_metric_delta= -0.062)
Alex: Is the metric computed in the harness or in postprocessing? Any diffs in outputs?
Maya: Harness reports non-deterministic outputs across seeds. Small sample diffs:
```
seed 42: "Top result: entity A"
seed 43: "Top result: entity B"
-- divergence starts at token idx 12 --
```
Liam: Running a quick bisect between commits 2238000000..2239009999 to see when outputs diverged.
ops-sre: No infra deploys at that window. Note: runtime branch "q8-kernel-opt" landed a kernel tweak yesterday.
Sophia: Also saw common-tokenizer bumped to v2.1 in the model-packages changelog — could affect token offsets.
Alex: Can we pin tokenizer to v2.0 in the harness and rerun a single failing job to confirm?
Maya: Pinned tokenizer to v2.0 in a local patch and reran the canary: NDCG back to baseline. So root cause appears to be tokenizer token-id remapping in v2.1.
Liam: I'll open PR to pin tokenizer in eval harness + add a deterministic-output unit test (gold sample compare) and a CI gate to catch this.
ops-sre: Recommend halt of llama3-lite-q8 canary rollout and revert the harness tokenizer change if it's already in prod paths. Marking release as on-hold.
Sophia: Agree — adding this to release-blockers doc and pinging product for decision. @product-team FYI.
Maya: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: Liam PR, Alex add goldset test, ops-sre coordinate rollback plan. :thumbsup:
Liam: PR drafted — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/472 (WIP)
Alex: I'll add the test and push later today.
ci-bot: CI job queued for PR 472
Maya: Good catch everyone. We'll hold the rollout until PR lands and CI passes. :lock:
